name: VCS source archives and refs
client: curl from the immutable Maven/Temurin image (runtime version recorded by native CI)
auth: Use a Bearer access/reference token for an identity with read permission on the remote repository. Upstream Git provider credentials are configured by the repository operator and are separate from the caller token.
fresh_home: Create a new AW_WORK with mktemp -d for every run; client configuration, downloads and caches in the commands stay under this directory. Do not reuse it to prove a fresh download. Remove the temporary directory after use.
prerequisites: An operator-created remote VCS repository configured for the intended upstream provider.

configure.note: This remote-only service has no Git-client registry configuration; it exposes an authorized archive/ref REST API.

publish.note: VCS repositories are remote-only. Publish commits and tags to the configured upstream Git provider; there is no artifactweave Git push endpoint.

install.note: Download a tagged source archive from the configured remote VCS provider.

steps.note: Replace team/project and v1.0.0 with the upstream project and tag. Inspect the archive before extracting it.

limitations: Local, virtual and federated VCS classes are not supported.
This is archive/ref REST access, not git clone, git fetch or git push.
curl --disable is the first option so a user curlrc cannot inject alternate credentials, URLs or output settings. The pinned image contains Ubuntu curl 8.18.0-1ubuntu2.8.

contains: a caller without read permission cannot discover remote refs
the curl archive recipe rejects an invalid token and returns exact source bytes
